text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is here. As Admire Vega gets ready, I ask her if she's nervous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surprisingly, she says yes. Until this moment, she cared about nothing but running for the sake of her duty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now, there's much more on her mind, like her own desire to win and her rivals. It seems all those jumbled thoughts are what's making her anxious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes off to where her rivals are waiting. She'll face them, carrying her anxiety, her true love for racing, and her earnest desire for victory.
